lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kaa abhimaan jor too kichh kichh kichh jaanataa ihu door karahu aapan gahu re ||
lines.translation: So you think that the egotistical pride in power which you harbor deep within is everything. Let it go, and restrain your self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har daiaal hohu suaamee har sa(n)tan kee dhoor kar hare ||2||1||2||
lines.translation: Please be kind to servant Nanak, O Lord, my Lord and Master; please make him the dust of the Feet of the Saints. ||2||1||2||
Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਪਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee sa(n)tasa(n)g jaagee || pri ra(n)g dekhai japatee naam nidhaanee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: O mother, I have awakened in the Society of the Saints. Seeing the Love of my Beloved, I chant His Name, the greatest treasure ||Pause||
I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. my eyes are focused on Him;
I have forgotten other thirsts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab gur paaio hai sahaj sukhadaaik darasan pekhat man lapataanee ||
lines.translation: Now, I have found my Peace-giving Guru with ease; seeing His Darshan, my mind clings to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dekh damodar rahas man upajio naanak pri a(n)mrit baanee ||2||1||
lines.translation: Seeing my Lord, joy has welled up in my mind; O Nanak, the speech of my Beloved is so sweet! ||2||1||
Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Please listen to the prayers of the humble, O Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਤੀਨਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch daas teen dokhee ek man anaath naath ||
lines.translation: The five thieves and the three dispositions torment my mind.
O Merciful Lord, Master of the masterless, please save me from them. ||Pause||
I make all sorts of efforts and go on pilgrimages;
I perform the six rituals, and meditate in the right way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਨਹ ਨਹ ਹੁਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: upaav sagal kar haario nah nah hutahi bikaraal ||1||
lines.translation: I am so tired of making all these efforts, but the horrible demons still do not leave me. ||1||
I seek Your Sanctuary, and bow to You, O Compassionate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਹਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhav haran har har har hare ||
lines.translation: You are the Destroyer of fear, O Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.
You alone are Merciful to the meek.
Nanak takes the Support of God's Feet.
I have been rescued from the ocean of doubt,
holding tight to the feet and the robes of the Saints. ||2||1||2||
Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Supreme Treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam preet laagee man bheetar maagan kau har daan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is enshrined within my mind; I beg for the gift of Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaaee pooran paramesur kar kirapaa raakhahu maan ||
lines.translation: O Pefect Transcendent Lord, Giver of Peace, please grant Your Grace and save my honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dehu preet saadhoo sa(n)g suaamee har gun rasan bakhaan ||1||
lines.translation: Please bless me with such love, O my Lord and Master, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I may chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with my tongue. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gopaal daiaal gobid damodar niramal kathaa giaan ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the World, Merciful Lord of the Universe, Your sermon and spiritual wisdom are immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਗਹੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau har kai ra(n)g raagahu charan kamal sa(n)g dhiaan ||2||1||3||
lines.translation: Please attune Nanak to Your Love, O Lord, and focus his meditation on Your Lotus Feet. ||2||1||3||
Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke darasan ko man chaau ||
lines.translation: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa satasa(n)g milaavahu tum devahu apano naau || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please grant Your Grace, and unite me with the Society of the Saints; please bless me with Your Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਤ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau sevaa sat purakh piaare jat suneeai tat man rahasaau ||
lines.translation: I serve my True Beloved Lord. Wherever I hear His Praise, there my mind is in ecstasy.
